title: DropMultiplier
description: A Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 that adds a drop multiplier system, allowing players or servers to multiply all block and mob drops using simple commands.
body:
Adds a /multiplier command into your Minecraft world. 

When using /multiplier there are 3 different sub commands that you can do

/multiplier ON turns on the multiplier and sets multiplier to 2

/multiplier OFF turns of multiplier

/multiplier NUMBER let's you set the amount of multiplier is done ranging numbers from 2 to 500.
